what: Letters rise one by one from 100% below their own cell, overshoot by -10%, and settle in place (an ease per segment) — .05s between letters, and the first letter also starts .05s late. Restarts from the beginning in .5s on every hover · with on: load it plays once on open in .6s (Hero greeting). The letter cell is clipped by overflow so letters appear to pop up from below

options.[data-fx-part=letters]: Text lines to split — if none, the whole text of the attached element. A blank also takes one slot in the order (original nth-child delay)
options.on: If load, plays once on open instead of on interaction
options.delay: Delay added to every character (sec), default 0
options.--fx-word-gap: Gap between words, default 4px (original space characters have width 0 with two gaps)

from.where: shared.js header Contact, index, works and news View More and More buttons (original m__btn .letter — animationBoundText .5s ease, :nth-child(n) delayed n×.05s)
